findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The shelf being used to store the Crumbl Cookie boxes is observed to have an accumulation of food debris/soils. PIC instructed an employee to clean and sanitize this shelf used to store these boxes. Ensure the shelf is cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
The edge of the cookie holder next to the final prep station is observed to have food accumulation in the gap. Ensure the current food debris is cleaned and then have this surface cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The inside of the microwave on the left is observed to have an accumulation of food debris that appears to have been spilt. Clean and sanitize this surface of the current accumulation and then clean and sanitize this surface at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The floor around the cooler wheels in the main kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of food debris. Ensure the current debris is cleaned up and then the floors are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
